open_points.subject: release host compatibility and startup
open_points.text: A release runs on Linux and on no other host, no version named
open_points.question: What owner or capability enforces the Linux-only restriction, and what stated outcome occurs when the release is started on a non-Linux or unsupported Linux host, given that `flow:start_and_recover_kernel` names no host-platform check?
options: The release/build system prevents producing or installing the artifact on other hosts
`module:surface` performs a startup host check and refuses to start with a named reason
No explicit enforcement; failure from unavailable Linux facilities is an unsupported-host outcome
open_points.default_guess: Treat Linux compatibility as a release-build constraint enforced outside the running kernel, with no runtime host check.
